features.prior_game_count: all admitted prior games for the team
features.prior_season_game_count: admitted prior games in the target season
features.days_since_last_game_start: elapsed days from the most recent admitted prior game start to target start; null for cold start
features.games_last_7d: admitted prior game starts in the trailing seven days
features.games_last_14d: admitted prior game starts in the trailing fourteen days
features.games_last_28d: admitted prior game starts in the trailing twenty-eight days
features.away_or_neutral_games_last_28d: trailing twenty-eight-day admitted games played away or at a neutral site
features.consecutive_away_or_neutral_games: consecutive admitted away-or-neutral games immediately before target
features.recent_5_margin_mean: mean team-oriented final margin over up to five admitted prior games
features.recent_5_opponent_pregame_win_share_mean: mean opponent pregame win share recorded at up to five admitted prior meetings; null where all opponent histories were absent
features.recent_5_opponent_adjusted_margin_mean: mean actual team margin minus the pregame team-minus-opponent historical margin expectation over up to five admitted prior games; null where no expectation was supported

limitations: The underlying source is retrospective event chronology, not original historical known-at evidence.
Game-start spacing is an observable workload proxy and is not labeled as physiological recovery.
No travel miles, time zones, altitude, venue transitions, or roof state are fabricated without pinned venue evidence.
Opponent adjustment uses only pregame historical team outcome state and is not an advanced efficiency measure.
Materialization alone does not establish predictive value or feature adoption.
